fares.title: Fares
fares.help: Price = max(minimum, base + per km × km + per minute × min) × surge, rounded up. Amounts in USD.
fares.roundingHelp: The final price is rounded up to this multiple.

surge.title: Surge pricing
surge.help: The higher of the active time rule and the manual surge applies. Caracas time.
surge.manualHelp: For one-off high demand. 1.00 = no surge.
surge.noRules: No rules: only the manual surge applies.

payments.title: Payment methods
payments.help: Methods the passenger can choose when requesting a ride.

area.title: Service area
area.help: One coordinate box per city; rides cannot be requested outside them, and pickup and drop-off must be in the same city.
area.name: City
area.polygon: This city has a polygon (edited in Zones): the box is computed from it.

dispatch.title: Dispatch
dispatch.offerTimeoutHelp: How long each driver has to accept an offer.
dispatch.searchTimeoutHelp: After this the ride ends as “no drivers”.
dispatch.quoteTtlHelp: Time to confirm a quoted price.
dispatch.radiiHelp: The search widens in this order, smallest first.

rates.title: Rates and promotions
rates.help: Stale exchange rate warnings, manual corrections and promotion abuse control.
rates.staleHelp: Past that age the panel flags the rate as stale.
rates.manualHoldHelp: Hours during which automatic fetches do not replace a manual rate.
rates.pairThresholdHelp: Promoted rides between the same passenger and driver that raise an alert.
rates.pairDaysHelp: Days back in which those rides are counted.

wallet.title: Wallet and subscription
wallet.help: Binance Pay top-ups, transfers between drivers and the monthly fee.
wallet.payIdMissing: Without a Kuulis Binance Pay ID drivers cannot top up.
wallet.payIdHelp: Shown to drivers to send USDT. Digits only, 6 to 20.
wallet.accountNameHelp: Name of the Kuulis Binance account, so drivers can confirm who they pay.
wallet.minAmountHelp: Minimum amount of each top-up notice.
wallet.transferLimitHelp: Maximum each driver can send per calendar month. Received amounts do not count. 0 disables transfers.
wallet.freeMonthsHelp: Counted from each driver's first completed ride.
wallet.graceDaysHelp: Days to pay after the charge before being blocked.

approvals.title: Four-eyes approval
approvals.help: Actions one person proposes and another approves in Approvals. While there is only one admin, nobody can approve fares and fee schedules: turn it off here if needed.
approvals.adjustLimitHelp: Adjustments above this amount, credit or debit, wait for approval. 0 turns it off.
approvals.faresHelp: Fare or rounding changes in Settings and new fee schedules. Only another admin can approve them.
approvals.broadcastsHelp: Notifications to everyone or a whole role, and sending campaigns. Single-user ones go out right away.
approvals.waiversHelp: Waiving a driver's fee or lowering it, also when it was already paid (the difference goes back to them).

app.title: Contact and location in the app
app.help: Support and legal links, and how often the driver app sends its location. The app reads them at start, no update needed. Maintenance and city pauses are in
app.emergencyNumberHelp: The emergency button dials it. Digits only.
app.intervalsHelp: Fewer seconds = a more accurate map, but more battery and data.

safety.title: Trip safety
safety.help: Start PIN, passenger photo and the rules that ask "Is everything OK?" before alerting the team.
safety.pinAreasHelp: The driver types the passenger's code to start the ride.
safety.anomaliesHelp: During the ride: a long stop away from the destination, leaving the route, or taking far longer than estimated.
safety.sosTeamHelp: On: every SOS goes to Telegram and rings in the Safety center. Off: the SOS calls 911 and alerts the trusted contacts; only the record stays here.

verification.title: Driver verification
verification.help: Expiring documents, random selfie, re-verification after reports and induction.
verification.expiringHelp: The driver types the date and a verifier confirms it. Once expired, they cannot go online until the new one is approved.
verification.optionalHelp: The driver may upload them without being asked (for example, the criminal record certificate).
verification.noticeDaysHelp: Comma separated, for example 30, 7, 1 (at most {max} days).
verification.noticeDaysInvalid: Type only numbers separated by commas
verification.selfieHelp: When going online, on a random day. 0 = no random selfie.
verification.inductionHelp: Before approving a driver, "Induction completed" must be marked on their profile (talk or video).

support.title: Support
support.help: Response times, auto-close, ticket assignment and lost items.

numbersHelp.sla_urgent_minutes: Deadline for the team's answer; then it shows as “Overdue”. Between {min} and {max}.
numbersHelp.sla_normal_hours: Deadline for the team's answer; then it shows as “Overdue”. Between {min} and {max}.
numbersHelp.auto_close_days: A ticket waiting on the user closes after these days. Between {min} and {max}.
numbersHelp.lost_item_days: Days after the ride the passenger can ask for it. Between {min} and {max}.
numbersHelp.lost_item_chat_hours: The chat with the driver stays open after “I have it”. Between {min} and {max}.

support.promiseHelp: What the app and the website show when writing. Empty = hidden. At most {max} characters.
support.autoAssignHelp: Each new ticket goes to the staff member with support permission and the fewest open tickets.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.help: Quiet hours, the marketing limit, inbox cleanup and the drivers' monthly summary.
notifications.quietHelp: Caracas time. No campaigns go out in these hours: they wait until they end. Each person can change their own in the app.
notifications.quietOff: Same start and end: no default quiet hours.

numbersHelp.marketing_daily_cap: Most campaigns each person gets in a day. 0 = no limit. Between {min} and {max}.
numbersHelp.inbox_retention_days: Older notifications are deleted from the inbox. Between {min} and {max}.
numbersHelp.device_idle_days: A phone that does not open the app in this many days stops getting push. Between {min} and {max}.

notifications.monthlySummaryHelp: On the 1st of each month every driver gets an email with last month's rides and earnings.

quality.title: Service quality
quality.help: How long to wait for the passenger, when a cancellation counts and what happens past the thresholds. Consequences never cost money: warnings, short pauses and a lower place in dispatch.

numbersHelp.pickup_wait_minutes: From the driver's arrival; then they may mark a no-show. Between {min} and {max}.
numbersHelp.passenger_cancel_grace_s: A passenger cancelling this soon after a driver accepts does not count. Between {min} and {max}.
numbersHelp.window_days: Rates use the rides of these last days. Between {min} and {max}.
numbersHelp.driver_cancel_warn: Cancellations over accepted rides: the driver gets a warning. Between {min} and {max}.
numbersHelp.driver_cancel_low_priority: Gets offers after better-rated drivers. Between {min} and {max}.
numbersHelp.driver_cancel_review: Shows in Quality for review. Between {min} and {max}.
numbersHelp.min_rides: Accepted rides in the window before rates apply. Between {min} and {max}.
numbersHelp.rating_review_below: With at least the minimum ratings. Between {min} and {max}.
numbersHelp.rating_min_count: Ratings in the window before the average is looked at. Between {min} and {max}.
numbersHelp.driver_cancel_burst: Within an hour: automatic pause. 0 = off. Between {min} and {max}.
numbersHelp.driver_decline_streak: Declined or ignored without accepting any: automatic pause. 0 = off. Between {min} and {max}.
numbersHelp.driver_pause_minutes: How long the driver's pause lasts. Between {min} and {max}.
numbersHelp.passenger_no_show_warn: In the window: the passenger gets a warning. 0 = off. Between {min} and {max}.
numbersHelp.passenger_no_show_pause: In the window: they cannot request rides for a while. 0 = off. Between {min} and {max}.
numbersHelp.passenger_pause_hours: How long the passenger's pause lasts. Between {min} and {max}.
numbersHelp.dispatch_quality_weight: How much rating and acceptance move a driver when offering rides: the worst driver counts as up to this much farther away. 0 = distance only. Between {min} and {max}.

risk.title: Anti-fraud
risk.help: Simple rules that raise alerts for someone to review. They never ban on their own: at most they hold a promotion credit or a transfer until it is reviewed.

numbersHelp.window_days: Alerts from these last days add up to the score (0 to 100). Between {min} and {max}.
numbersHelp.freeze_score: From this score promotion credits wait for review and outgoing transfers are blocked. Between {min} and {max}.
numbersHelp.ride_hold_score: When a ride's findings add up to this, its promotion credit waits for review. Between {min} and {max}.
numbersHelp.min_path_share: Real path under this share of the route = little movement. Between {min} and {max}.
numbersHelp.min_duration_share: Real duration under this share of the estimate = too short. Between {min} and {max}.
numbersHelp.same_place_m: Started and ended closer than this. Between {min} and {max}.
numbersHelp.min_ride_m: The path and same-place rules only look at rides at least this long. Between {min} and {max}.
numbersHelp.pair_rides: The same passenger and driver with this many rides together. Between {min} and {max}.
numbersHelp.pair_days: Period to count the pair's rides. Between {min} and {max}.
numbersHelp.max_accounts_per_device: More accounts than this on one phone raise an alert. Between {min} and {max}.
numbersHelp.jump_alerts: Jumps faster than 150 km/h within 10 minutes before alerting. Between {min} and {max}.
numbersHelp.first_transfer_hold_hours: The first transfer of each account waits this long. 0 = off. Between {min} and {max}.
numbersHelp.chain_minutes: Sending received money on within this time raises an alert. Between {min} and {max}.
numbersHelp.fan_in_senders: Receiving from this many different people in 7 days raises an alert. Between {min} and {max}.
numbersHelp.new_account_days: Accounts newer than this receiving balance raise an alert. 0 = off. Between {min} and {max}.
numbersHelp.rating_ring_rides: Rides in 30 days where both gave each other 5 stars. Between {min} and {max}.

rides.search: Search by passenger, driver, plate or ID
rides.invalidRange: The start date is after the end date; the range is ignored.

cancel.title: Cancel ride
cancel.help: The passenger and the driver will be notified. This cannot be undone.

rides.discountHelp: The passenger pays the total to the driver; Kuulis credits the discount to the driver when the ride completes.

safety.title: Safety
safety.pinOk: Start PIN required, no wrong tries

cancellations.title: Cancellations
cancellations.help: Every cancellation of the ride. When the driver cancels, the ride looks for another one.
cancellations.countedHelp: Whether it counts in their cancellation rate (grace-period cancellations and no-shows do not).

live.demandDisabled: The demand map is turned off in the settings.

rates.noRate: No rate for this source yet.
rates.staleHelp: It is older than {age}. Check the source or enter a manual rate.
rates.readOnly: Only administrators can correct or fetch rates.

manual.title: Manual correction
manual.help: A manual rate holds for {n} h: during that time automatic fetches do not replace it.

promotions.name: Name
promotions.noRides: No ride has used it yet.

stats.help: Credited: discounts paid to drivers for completed rides. Reserved: rides in progress. Uses: rides in progress and completed.

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.rule: Passenger–driver pairs with {n} or more promoted rides in the last {days} days.
alerts.help: Many discounted rides between the same two people may mean fake rides to cash in promotions. Review the rides before acting.

form.codeHelp: 3 to 20 letters or digits. The passenger types it when quoting.
form.automaticHelp: Without a code the promotion applies by itself to whoever qualifies (the largest discount wins).
form.activeHelp: A paused promotion does not apply even within its validity.
form.discountHelp: Kuulis pays for the discount: the passenger pays the fare minus the discount and Kuulis credits it to the driver. It never exceeds the fare.
form.maxDiscountHelp: Cap per ride; empty = no cap.
form.minFareHelp: Fare from which it applies; 0 = any.
form.validityHelp: Dates and times in your time zone ({zone}).
form.budgetHelp: Credited plus reserved never exceeds this amount.
form.budgetCommitted: Already committed: {amount}. It cannot go below that.
form.firstRideOnlyHelp: Only for passengers without completed rides.
form.scopeHelp: Leave everything unchecked to apply to every city and vehicle.

errors.nameTooLong: The name allows up to {max} characters.
errors.descriptionTooLong: The description allows up to {max} characters.
errors.code: The code must have 3 to 20 letters (A–Z) or digits, or be empty.
errors.maxDiscount: The maximum discount must be greater than 0 or empty.
errors.fixed: The fixed amount must be greater than 0.
errors.minFare: The minimum fare must be 0 or more.
errors.dates: Enter start and end date and time.
errors.endBeforeStart: The end must be after the start.
errors.budget: The budget must be greater than 0.
errors.budgetBelowCommitted: The budget cannot be lower than what is already committed ({amount}).
errors.maxUsesPerPassenger: Uses per passenger: a whole number between 1 and {max}.
errors.maxTotalUses: Total uses: a whole number between 1 and {max}, or empty.

wallet.title: Wallet
wallet.none: This driver has no wallet yet.

adjust.title: Adjust balance
adjust.description: Add or subtract balance by hand. It is recorded in the ledger with your name and the reason.
adjust.descriptionFor: Add or subtract balance for {name}. It is recorded in the ledger with your name and the reason.
adjust.amountHelp: Positive to add, negative to subtract.

topUps.search: Search by name, email, reference or Pay ID
topUps.referenceHelp: Order ID in the Binance Pay history.
topUps.receivedAmountHelp: What actually reached the Kuulis account according to Binance; this is what gets credited.
topUps.findDriverHelp: Type at least 2 characters of the name, email, ID number or plate.

actions.confirmHelp: Check in Binance Pay that the payment arrived before crediting it.
actions.rejectHelp: The driver will see this reason. Use it when the payment did not arrive or does not match.
actions.assignHelp: The payment reached Kuulis but its Pay ID matches no driver. Choose who it belongs to.

help.title: How top-ups work
help.step1: The driver registers their Binance Pay ID in the app.
help.step2: They send USDT through Binance Pay to Pay ID {payId} ({name}). Minimum top-up: {min}.
help.step2Missing: They send USDT through Binance Pay to the Kuulis account. No Pay ID is configured yet: drivers cannot top up until you add it in
help.step3: In the app they notify the payment (with the order ID, if they have it); the notice shows up here as pending.
help.automatic: Automatic reconciliation is on: every minute the Binance Pay history is checked and each USDT payment whose payer matches a driver's Pay ID is credited. Payments that match nobody stay as "Unmatched" to be assigned by hand.
help.manual: Manual reconciliation: the server has no Binance credentials, so each pending notice is credited here after checking the payment in Binance.
help.unknownMode: If the server has Binance credentials, payments are credited automatically when the payer's Pay ID matches a driver's, and the rest stay "Unmatched". Without them, each pending notice is credited here by hand after checking it in Binance.
help.statuses: Crediting a top-up closes the driver's oldest pending notice and retries any pending fee.

transfers.help: Balance sent between drivers. Limit per driver: {limit} sent per month.
transfers.heldHelp: Held for an anti-fraud review: the recipient has not received it yet.
transfers.returnedHelp: Voided in the anti-fraud review: the money went back to the sender.

totals.waivedHelp: Due to low earnings, the free period or an admin decision.
totals.partial: There are too many charges to count them all here: some totals are partial.

waive.title: Waive or lower fee
waive.help: 0 waives the fee; a lower amount reduces it. If the driver was blocked, they are unblocked right away.
waive.helpPaid: The fee is already paid: the difference goes back to the driver's wallet.
waive.newFeeHelp: 0 waives it. It must be lower than the current fee ({fee}).

errors.fee: Enter a valid amount of 0 or more.
errors.notLower: It must be lower than the current fee.

run.title: Charge a closed month
run.help: The worker does this on day 1 of every month (Caracas time). Use it if that run failed or was skipped.
run.confirm: {month} will be charged to every driver with completed rides that month. It is safe to repeat: nobody is charged twice.

schedules.title: Tiers
schedules.how: The month's fee is the one of the highest tier the earnings exceed; a month without earnings costs 0. Each month uses the latest schedule in force, and a new schedule can only start next month or later, so a closed month never changes.
schedules.newHelp: Starts from the latest schedule. Each row is "earnings above" → fee. The first one starts at 0.

errors.month: Choose the month it applies from.
errors.monthTooEarly: It must start in {month} or later.
errors.firstAbove: The first tier must start at 0.
errors.above: Tier {n}: the threshold must be a valid amount of 0 or more.
errors.increasing: Tier {n}: the threshold must be greater than the previous tier's.
errors.fee: Tier {n}: the fee must be between 0 and {max}.
errors.monthTaken: A schedule is already planned for that month: choose another one.

simulator.title: Tier simulator
simulator.help: Works out the fees of an already billed month with the current tiers and with proposed ones. It changes nothing: to apply new tiers create a schedule under "Tiers".
simulator.proposedHelp: They start from the current tiers. Each row is "earnings above" → fee; the first starts at 0.
simulator.matches: The current tiers reproduce exactly what was billed.
simulator.noMatch: The current tiers do not reproduce what was billed ({billed}): check adjustments, waivers or a tier change that month.

suspensions.title: Account suspension

modal.effects: They will not be able to request rides or go online as a driver (if online, they are taken offline). Rides in progress continue. They can log in, see their history and wallet, and file reports.
modal.replaces: Already suspended: this suspension replaces the current one
modal.fromReport: A note about this suspension will be added to the report.

suspensions.reasonHelp: 3 to 500 characters. The person will see this reason.
suspensions.customUntilHelp: Ends when that day ends (Caracas time).
suspensions.customInvalid: Pick today or a later day
suspensions.willNotEnd: It does not end on its own: it has to be lifted manually.

reports.title: Support tickets

categoryHelp.vehicle_mismatch: the bike or the person did not match

reports.resolveHint: When you resolve or dismiss, your answer is sent as a message and the person is asked to rate the support.

notes.title: Internal notes
notes.help: Notes are not sent to anyone.

resolve.dismissedHelp: Closes the report without action (not applicable or not enough information).
resolve.visibleHelp: The answer stays in the conversation and the person is notified (by email if they wrote from the website), then they can rate the support. Do not include internal notes or the other person's data.

help.title: How to reconcile against the Binance statement
help.step1: Pick the same period as the Binance Pay statement (dates are Caracas time; Binance shows UTC, so check movements near midnight).
help.step2: What Binance received in the period must match "Top-ups credited". Download the top-ups CSV (status credited) and compare each order by its transaction or reference.
help.step3: A payment in Binance but not in the CSV is usually "unmatched" or "pending": resolve it in Top-ups. One in the CSV but not in Binance is a manual confirmation to review.
help.step4: To check balances use the entries CSV: each row has the balance after the movement.
help.balances: "Wallet balances" does not depend on the period: it is what drivers hold in Kuulis today, the money Kuulis owes them in service.

cards.feesPendingHelp: Pending fees do not depend on the period
cards.promoCreditsHelp: What Kuulis credited to drivers for discounts.
cards.transfersHelp: They do not change the wallet total
cards.walletBalancesHelp: Sum of every balance right now: what Kuulis "owes" in service. It should be backed by what is in the Binance account.

export.title: Export CSV
export.help: From {from} to {to}. Opens in Excel or Google Sheets.
export.entriesHelp: Date, user, kind, amount, balance after, reference and detail.
export.topUpsHelp: Created, credited, status, origin, amount, driver, payer, transaction and reference.

system.title: System status
system.noDriversLastHour: No driver in the last hour
system.dashboardAlertHelp: A service or background loop has problems.

backups.title: Backups
backups.notConfigured: Off-site backups are not configured (worker BACKUP_* variables).

ledger.title: Wallet ledger
ledger.help: Daily check: every balance is the sum of its entries, nothing is negative and each Binance payment is credited only once.

totp.title: Two-step verification
totp.setupHelp: Scan the code with Google Authenticator, Aegis or similar and type the 6-digit code it shows.
totp.codeHelp: Type the 6-digit code from your authenticator app (or a recovery code).
totp.recoveryHelp: Keep them somewhere safe. Each one signs you in once if you lose your phone. They are not shown again.
totp.reauthHelp: This is a sensitive action. Type the code from your authenticator app.
totp.resetHelp: If they lost their phone, reset it: they set up a new one at their next sign-in and their sessions end.
totp.resetConfirm: Reset two-step verification for this account? Their sessions will end.
totp.resetDone: Done: they will set up their authenticator when they sign in again
totp.qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app

audit.help: Every team action in the admin and every view of sensitive data is recorded here. It cannot be edited or deleted.

team.help: People with admin access. Each one sees and does only what their role allows; admins can do everything.
team.inviteHelp: They get an email with a link (valid for 3 days) to create their password, then set up 2FA when signing in.
team.name: Name

invite.title: Join the Kuulis team
invite.help: Create your account password. Then sign in to the admin and set up your authenticator (2FA).
invite.done: Done, your password is set. You can sign in now.
invite.noToken: The link is incomplete. Ask for a new invitation.

approvals.help: High-impact changes waiting for a second person: large balance adjustments, fares and fee schedules, fee waivers and mass notifications. Whoever asks for a change cannot approve it. Requests expire after 48 hours.
approvals.approveHint: The change is applied now, on behalf of {email}.
approvals.held: Sent for approval: someone else has to approve it

legal.help: Legal texts users see in the app. Each version is published in Spanish and English. If it requires accepting again, nobody can request or accept rides until they accept it. The current drafts are pending a lawyer's review.

who.community: Linked from the terms; not accepted separately.

legal.publishHelp: Published as the next version in both languages. Earlier versions are kept.
legal.summaryHelp: Users see it on the "We updated our terms" screen.
legal.reacceptHelp: Use it for important changes. Minor changes (typos, clarifications) do not need it.
legal.noAcceptances: Has not accepted any text yet.

privacy.deletionsHelp: Accounts whose owner asked to delete them. For 30 days they can get it back by signing in; then their personal data is erased and their rides and payments stay without a name.
privacy.exportsHelp: Copies of their data that users asked for (one a day). The link lasts 24 hours, then the file is deleted.
privacy.userErased: Account deleted on {date}: its personal data is already erased.
privacy.userScheduledHelp: Asked for on {date}. Signing in to the app before then restores the account.

versions.help: Versions of the Android app (APK) offered to users. The app and the website offer the newest version of their channel that is not withdrawn. Withdrawing a version offers the previous one again; marking it mandatory stops older builds from requesting or accepting rides until they update.
versions.buildsHelp: APKs the compiler uploaded for this environment, newest first.
versions.usageHelp: Distinct people who used each build in the last 7 days.
versions.publishHelp: The app and the website will offer this build to whoever uses the chosen channel.
versions.channelHelp: QA: testing team. Beta: invited testers. Production: every user.
versions.notesHelp: What changed. Users see it when updating.
versions.mandatoryHelp: People on an older build of this channel will not be able to request or accept rides until they update. Use it only for critical fixes or incompatible changes.
versions.confirmMandatory: People on an older build in the {channel} channel will not be able to request or accept rides until they update to this version.
versions.confirmOptional: Older builds can be used again, unless another mandatory version blocks them.
versions.confirmWithdraw: It stops being offered in the {channel} channel: the previous version is offered again. People who already installed it keep it. If it was mandatory, it stops blocking older builds.
versions.confirmRestore: It is offered again in the {channel} channel (if it is the newest build) and, if mandatory, blocks older builds again.

ota.title: JavaScript updates (OTA)
ota.help: Changes to the JavaScript code that arrive without installing a new APK. Only apps built with the same native code (runtime) receive them. The app downloads them in the background and applies them the next time it is opened, never in the middle of a ride. The percentage picks a stable share of devices: the same phone is always in or out.
ota.candidatesHelp: JavaScript bundles the compiler uploaded for this environment, newest first.
ota.usageHelp: Distinct people who used each update in the last 7 days.
ota.publishHelp: Apps in the chosen channel with the same runtime will download it and apply it when they are opened again.
ota.rolloutHelp: Start small (10 %) to test and widen once everything looks fine. 0 % leaves it paused.
ota.confirmPause: It stops reaching new devices in the {channel} channel. Devices that already downloaded it keep it.
ota.confirmFull: It will reach every app in the {channel} channel with the same runtime.
ota.confirmRevert: It is withdrawn in the {channel} channel and the apps receive a newer copy of the previous update that was at 100 % or, if there is none, go back to the APK's code. The change applies the next time the app is opened.

control.englishFallback: Leave empty to show the Spanish text

appStatus.help: Stop new rides without shipping a release: maintenance in every city or some of them, or a pause in one city (heavy rain, protests, curfew). Rides under way go on; online drivers go offline when their ride ends.
appStatus.readOnly: Read only: your role can see the status but not change it.
appStatus.onBody: Nobody can get quotes or request rides, and drivers cannot go online. The app shows this message:
appStatus.allGood: The app is working normally in every city.
appStatus.maintenanceHelp: Maintenance screen in the app and no new rides where it applies.
appStatus.messageHelp: Explain what is going on and what they can do. Up to 300 characters.
appStatus.etaHelp: Optional. In your browser's time; the app shows it in the user's time.
appStatus.pausesHelp: Stop new rides in one city with its own message, leaving the rest alone.
appStatus.pauseModalHelp: Nobody can request rides or go online as a driver in that city until you resume it.
appStatus.pauseMessageHelp: For example: “Rides are paused because of the rain. We'll be back as soon as it is safe.”

errors.eta: The estimated time is not valid.

maintenanceOn.title: Turn maintenance on?
maintenanceOn.body: New rides stop in {where}: nobody can get quotes or request rides, and online drivers go offline when their ride ends. Apps find out within seconds.

pauseUpdate.title: Save the pause in {area}?

preview.unsaved: You have unsaved changes: the preview uses what is saved.

outcomes.passenger_ok: The passenger said they were OK

safety.pick: Pick an alert to see its details.

serviceTokens.help: Keys that let a program (the marketing agents) use the API as a team account. They only open screens that ask for a permission, and only with the permissions you tick. Keep them in environment variables, never in a chat or the repository.
serviceTokens.createHelp: The token acts as the account you pick and can never do more than its role.
serviceTokens.name: Name
serviceTokens.accountHelp: A team account with a role (not an admin). What the token does is audited under its name.
serviceTokens.permissionsHelp: Only those of that account's role. If the role loses a permission, so does the token.
serviceTokens.expiresHelp: Optional. Without a date it works until you revoke it.
serviceTokens.noAccounts: There are no active team accounts with a role. Invite one first (for example “Marketing agents” with the Marketing role).
serviceTokens.onceTitle: Copy it now: it won't be shown again
serviceTokens.onceHelp: Paste it straight into the environment variable where it will be used. If you lose it, revoke it and create another.
serviceTokens.revokeHelp: “{name}” stops working at once. This can't be undone.
